exact_integer_proof_and_CPU_oracle.proof: For L=ceil(log2(d)), M=ceil(2^(32+L)/d): M/2^(32+L) >= 1/d and the positive error times any uint32 x is strictly less than 2^-L <= 1/d. Every noninteger x/d is at least 1/d below the next integer, so floor(x*M/2^(32+L))=floor(x/d). With M=2^32+m, high=umulhi(x,m), ((x-high)>>1)+high avoids overflow and yields the same quotient after shifting L-1. q*d <= x, so x-q*d is the original exact uint32 remainder.

early_gate.decision_criteria: At least 3% complete B60 resample and 1.5% complete PR step or migration-inclusive five epochs, with at least 4/5 improving rounds; additional checks needed before adoption.
